name: stc Bahrain Data Center - Tubli
notes: stc Bahrain markets certified colocation/data-center services in Bahrain; Data Center Map lists the Tubli facility in the Manama area.

name: stc Bahrain Data Center - Seef
notes: stc Bahrain operates carrier/enterprise data-center services; directory evidence places a second stc facility in Seef, Capital Governorate.

name: Zain Bahrain Data Center - Manama
notes: Zain announced a 2.2 MW Bahrain data center; public facility directories place Zain's Bahrain data center in Manama.

name: National Bank of Bahrain Data Center
notes: NBB announced launch of a new data centre, reported as Tier III design certified; treated as a private enterprise facility in the Manama/Capital banking hub.

name: AWS Direct Connect - Manama
notes: AWS announced its first Direct Connect location in Bahrain at Manama; this is a network access/colocation point rather than a full public hyperscale data-center campus.

name: stc Bahrain Data Center Park - Al Qurain
notes: stc Bahrain announced the first phase of a 60 MW data center park at Al Qurain, tied to subsea cable connectivity and cloud/AI workloads.

name: Beyon Data Oasis White Space Data Center
notes: Beyon launched/announced a Data Oasis white-space data center facility in southern Bahrain; exact MW capacity was not disclosed in the source.

name: AWS Middle East (Bahrain) Region - Southern Bahrain availability-zone sites
notes: AWS opened the Bahrain Region with three availability zones in 2019; AWS does not publish precise facility addresses, but public data-center directories identify an AWS facility at Askar in Southern Governorate.

name: Global Zone Data Center - Askar
notes: PeeringDB lists Global Zone Datacenter in Askar and Manama-IX lists Global Zone as a connected facility partner; used as evidence of an operational interconnection data-center site.

name: Batelco/Beyon Data Center - Hamala
notes: Batelco opened a 2.75 MW data center in Hamala; Beyon/Batelco later referenced its Bahrain data-center operations and AWS partner role.

name: AWS Middle East (Bahrain) Region - Hamala availability-zone site
notes: AWS confirms the Bahrain Region with multiple AZs; public facility directories identify an AWS site at Hamala in Northern Governorate, though AWS does not disclose exact data-center locations.
